title: Llama Manager
description: Buy shop llamas in any quantity, open unopened inventory llamas in bulk, and handle choice packs (CP) with manual selection from the launcher.

bulk.mini-hint: Buy Mini Llamas (paid with Mini Llama tokens) on all selected accounts
bulk.upgrade-hint: Buy Upgrade Llamas (paid with X-Ray tickets) on all selected accounts
bulk.load-first: Load llamas first so the offer and its price can be shown

inventory.empty: No unopened regular llamas on this account.

shop.empty: No shop llamas available right now.

confirm.bulk: Buy up to {{count}} × {{name}} on each of {{accounts}} account(s).
confirm.bulk-price: Price: {{price}} {{currency}} each, up to {{perAccount}} {{currency}} per account ({{total}} {{currency}} in total).
confirm.bulk-cap: Each account buys only what its balance and daily limit allow. Accounts where the offer or price differs are skipped.

choice.hint: Choice packs (CP) let you pick a specific reward. Select options in the dialog or open with the default index.
choice.title: Select choice pack reward
choice.manual-hint: If options are not listed, enter the index manually (usually 0 = first option).

toasts.choice-only: These packs need choice selection — use the Choice (CP) tab.
toasts.error_price: The offer price changed. Load llamas again and retry
toasts.error_vbucks: V-Bucks offers can't be bought from the Llama Manager
toasts.error_no-mini-offer: Mini Llama offer not found in shop
toasts.error_no-upgrade-offer: Upgrade Llama offer not found in shop
toasts.error_limit: Daily limit or not enough currency
